meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 指定一个文件、函数或模块后,Claude 会先在代码知识图谱里定位它,再读源码,说明它属于哪一层、内部含哪些结构、被谁调用依赖,以及数据怎么流动。
howto.when: 当你想深入理解某个具体文件、函数或模块时触发。前提是 `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json` 已存在;若没有,它会让你先运行 `/understand`。

say.text: 解释一下 src/auth/login.ts 这个文件
say.note: 查图谱并读源码,给出深度说明

say.text: 讲讲 src/auth/login.ts 里的 verifyToken 函数
say.note: 定位该函数节点,展开它的连接与依赖
在图谱的 layers 里查它的归属层级

howto.what_en: Point Claude at a file, function, or module and it locates the node in the knowledge graph, reads the source, then explains its architectural layer, internal structure, callers and dependencies, and data flow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module. Requires .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json; if it is missing, it tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.note: reads the graph and source for a deep dive

say_en.text: Walk me through verifyToken in src/auth/login.ts
say_en.note: locates the node, then traces its edges and flow

say_en.text: Which layer does src/utils/format.ts belong to?
say_en.note: looks up the node's layer in the graph
